title: デビュー戦の後に・予想外のライバルズ

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! And that's how I run! Doesn't it just make your heart race? I'm going to keep this up and defeat Taiki with this speed of mine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Taiki's not going to make her debut anytime soon? What am I supposed to do with this burning passion now?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: On the bright side, my junior year is now mine for the taking! First up is the Daily Hai Junior Stakes! Keep your eyes on me, everyone!
